title: A Shopify Theme Won't Bring You a Single Sale. Here's Why #Shorts
description:
An honest breakdown from a Shopify theme developer.

No theme can fix weak product photos, an offer nobody gets in 3 seconds, or a pile of heavy apps slowing your store. Traffic is marketing. A theme's job is to convert the people who land.

Once the base is ready, a premium theme takes over the road to checkout: clear pricing, size guides, cart upsells and a free-shipping bar.
